fn.en: Describe how a person looks and what they are like.
fn.ru: Описывать, как человек выглядит и какой он.
fn.kk: Адамның сыртқы келбетін және мінезін сипаттау.

can.en: I can describe how a person looks and what they are like.
can.ru: Я могу описать, как человек выглядит и какой он.
can.kk: Адамның сыртқы келбетін және мінезін сипаттай аламын.

tip.en: Adjective before noun: a tall young man. Never “a man tall”.
tip.ru: Прилагательное перед существительным: a tall young man. Не «a man tall».
tip.kk: Сын есім зат есімнің алдында: a tall young man. «a man tall» емес.

items.q: You see her for one second. You know she is…
He speaks five languages, so he is…
In a photo you can see…
She talks to everybody in the office, so she is…
On the street you can see his…
His friends laugh a lot, so he is…
He speaks five languages. He’s very ___.
Everybody laughs with him. He’s very ___.
She never says much in meetings. She’s very ___.
She always helps people. She’s very ___.

items.why: hair and eyes go with have / has. Height and age go with be.

items.q: My grandfather ___ eighty and he ___ white hair.

items.why: Size comes before age: a tall young man.
Length comes before colour: short brown hair.

items.s: My brother is very ___ — one metre ninety. 📏
Our new colleague is very ___ — she talks to everybody. 🤝
He never says much. He’s a ___ man. 🤫
She speaks five languages. She’s very ___. 🧠

items.a: My sister has got blue eyes
He’s eighty and he has white hair

tts: These women are Japanese Maiko. Their style is very traditional. They have black hair and white faces. They put white and red flowers on top of their heads. On their bodies they wear a traditional dress. On their feet they wear big shoes made of wood.

items.s: They put flowers on their heads.

acts.title: The people in my office
text: My manager is a tall young woman. 📏
She has short brown hair and green eyes. 💇👀
She’s very clever and very kind. 🧠💚
My colleague Marat is short and he has black hair.
He’s quiet, but he’s very funny at lunch. 🤫😄

items.sit: You describe your sister. Her hair is long and black.
Someone asks about your brother. He is one metre ninety.
You describe your friend’s eyes. They are blue.
You describe the new man in the office: he is tall and about 25.

write.q: Describe two people you know: 5 sentences. Use has for hair and eyes, is for height, age and personality.
write.model: My sister is a tall young woman. She has long black hair and brown eyes. She’s very funny and very kind. My manager is short and he has white hair. He’s quiet, but he’s clever.

speak.q: Describe one person in your family out loud: how they look and what they are like.
speak.model: My brother is a tall young man. He has short brown hair and green eyes. He’s very friendly and he’s funny, but he’s quiet at work.

lines: I [always|am always|always am] get up at six. I [never|not never|don’t never] drink coffee at night.
My sister [doesn’t|don’t|not] drive. She [goes|go|does go] by bus.
[How often|How many|How much] do you study English? — Twice a week.
[Where|What|Who] does your brother work? — In a hospital.
I [can|cans|can to] swim, but I [don’t|can’t|doesn’t] swim often.
